result.title: Representational Difference Distillation
result.summary: Knowledge distillation transfers representational knowledge from a large teacher network to a compact student. Existing relational and contrastive distillation methods treat all samples uniformly, spending equal gradient on well-matched and poorly-matched regions of the representation space alike. We propose Representational Difference Distillation (RDD), which diagnoses where teacher and student representations structurally disagree and concentrates the distillation signal on those regions. RDD uses two asymmetric affinity matrices that capture opposing directions of misalignment: one identifies samples the student incorrectly considers similar, the other identifies teacher relationships the student has yet to learn. These affinities determine which sample pairs the distillation loss aligns and how strongly it corrects each misaligned sample. On CIFAR-100 with resnet32x4 to resnet8x4, RDD reaches 75.58% test accuracy in our runs, on par with CRD (75.45%) and above KD and RKD. We additionally explore curriculum-based and sampling-based variants, finding that weighting the loss is more effective than filtering the data.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Representational Difference Distillation（RDD）：用两个非对称亲和矩阵刻画师生表示空间中的相反方向错配，从而决定对齐哪些样本对、以多大力度纠正每个错配样本，在 CIFAR-100 的 resnet32x4→resnet8x4 上验证，并比较课程式与采样式变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先诊断表示结构性分歧、再据此加权监督信号」的思路可能可供核查：迁移到 LVR 时或可用于定位学生 latent 推理状态与教师状态不一致的样本或关系并集中训练信号，但原论文限于图像分类蒸馏，关联属推测。
